title: Amazon S3 Security
summary: How to protect data in Amazon S3: the server-side encryption options (SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, DSSE-KMS, SSE-C) and client-side encryption, forcing HTTPS, default encryption versus bucket policies, CORS, MFA Delete, server access logs, pre-signed URLs, WORM storage with Glacier Vault Lock and S3 Object Lock, access points with VPC origins and S3 Object Lambda.
